description: Single updater, GitHub-native automerge, release-age soak. Policy is inline rather than inherited from github>unional/renovate-preset: that preset's published default.json is only {"extends": ["config:base", ":preserveSemverRanges"]} and carries none of this policy, so extending it is inert (verified 2026-09-01). rebaseWhen is 'auto', not 'behind-base-branch': this repo has a merge queue and therefore strict_required_status_checks_policy off, so forced rebases would re-run the full matrix on every open PR each time main moves — the O(n^2) CI the queue exists to remove.

packageRules.description: React 19 is unreachable: @just-web/react@9 (latest) peers on react ^16 || ^17 || ^18, and react-codemirror2-react-17 is React-17-only. Drop this rule once @just-web/react declares a react ^19 peer.
